svg.aria-label: Engineering approach, an iterative process. 1. Understand before changing: Explore the existing system and its constraints. 2. Solve the actual problem: Prefer useful, measurable improvements over unnecessary complexity. 3. Build for maintainability: Write code that remains understandable as a project evolves. 4. Respect the existing system: Modernize without losing essential behavior. 5. Keep learning: Challenge assumptions, explore new tools, and deepen my technical understanding. Good engineering is not about adding layers of complexity. It is about finding the simplest solution that correctly addresses the problem.
